home.hero.title: Every student can be good at maths.
home.hero.subtitle: A learning platform that finds the exact gap holding your child back — then closes it with practice that never runs out. Built by Thầy Hiếu & Cô Triền.
home.hero.trust: No card needed · Free forever plan · Cancel any time
home.why.title: Most platforms give more questions. We find the right ones.
home.why.subtitle: Practice only helps when it targets what a student cannot yet do. Everything here is built around knowing exactly what that is.
home.why.mastery.title: Mastery, not marks
home.why.mastery.body: We track the probability a student truly knows each skill — so a lucky guess never counts as understanding.
home.why.adaptive.title: It knows what to do next
home.why.adaptive.body: The learning path unlocks skills only once their foundations are in place. No student is pushed into work they are not ready for.
home.why.infinite.title: Practice that never repeats
home.why.infinite.body: Every question is generated fresh from a template. Students cannot memorise answers — they have to learn the method.
home.why.teachers.title: Real teachers behind it
home.why.teachers.body: The platform shows teachers exactly where each student is stuck, so lesson time is spent on what actually matters.
home.subjects.title: Two subjects, taught properly
home.subjects.mathematics: From fractions to quadratics, each skill built on the one before.
home.subjects.physics: From measurement to electromagnetism, always anchored to a calculation.
home.how.title: Four steps, then it looks after itself
home.how.step1.title: Take a short assessment
home.how.step1.body: Fifteen minutes tells us which skills are solid and which are not.
home.how.step2.title: Get your learning path
home.how.step2.body: A clear sequence of skills, in the right order, starting where you actually are.
home.how.step3.title: Practise a little each day
home.how.step3.body: Short sessions with instant feedback, hints when you are stuck, and a worked solution every time.
home.how.step4.title: Watch mastery grow
home.how.step4.body: You and your parents see real progress per skill — not a vague grade.
home.formats.title: Choose how you want to study
home.formats.subtitle: Every option includes full access to the practice platform.
home.results.title: What changes for our students
home.cta.title: Start with a free assessment
home.cta.subtitle: Fifteen minutes, no cost, no obligation — and you will know exactly where your child stands.
